name: Puigcerdà (Spain)
description: Red field with the yellow mount floretty of the arms towards the hoist.
history: The flag was approved on 7 June 2005 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4418 of 4 July 2005; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, red, with the yellow mount floretty of the arms, 5/6 of the height and 1/3 of the length, centred at 1/6 from the hoist edge.

features.role: mount floretty (puig) of the arms, 5/6 of the height, centred at 1/6 from the hoist
